title: 2023 Topps Holiday #H93 Gabriel Moreno Arizona Diamondbacks Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2023 Topps Holiday trading card featuring rookie player Gabriel Moreno from the Arizona Diamondbacks. This standard-sized baseball card is part of the 2023 Topps Holiday set, manufactured by Topps. It is a base set card with the card number H93, representing the Major League (MLB) season of 2023. This sports trading card is a great collectible for fans of the Arizona Diamondbacks and baseball enthusiasts alike.
